details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements are consistent with each other and follow logical relationships. The summary progresses logically from consolidated performance to segment results, financial position, and future outlook. There are no self-contradictions, and while there is a minor decline in some profitability metrics, the explanations provided (completion of large projects, sector margin normalization, write-downs) consistently explain these changes. The arithmetic relationships between segment figures and consolidated totals are not claimed to be exhaustive additive components, so differences do not constitute contradictions. The organization is clear, moving from overview to details and ending with future prospects. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity.
